improvement.name: Windows-portable generated evidence names
improvement.problem: Ferrum safeName could emit Win32 reserved device names such as CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, and LPT1-LPT9, including those names followed by an extension, and could leave a trailing period. Those outputs are not portable through ordinary Windows filename APIs/UI and could break user-authored screenshot/evidence names.
implementation: Detect reserved Win32 device-name stems after Ferrum existing character and length normalization and prefix them with an underscore.
Strip trailing periods after normalization while preserving the pre-existing 80-character maximum.
Add deterministic mappings for reserved bare names, reserved names with extensions, trailing periods, blank-after-normalization output, normal names, and the length bound.
Extend the existing real Chromium self-test with a screenshot action named CON so the same code path is exercised in real Linux and Windows browser evidence rather than only as a helper test.
acceptance: Microsoft Win32 naming contract establishes the before-state as invalid for reserved device names and trailing periods.
Unit regressions pass on the exact proposal head.
Real Windows Chromium smoke creates and retains screenshots/_CON.png from a user-authored screenshot name CON.
The downloaded exact Windows evidence artifact hashes identically to the GitHub provider digest and its manifest records _CON.png as image/png with SHA-256.
Full affected Ferrum CI and companion workflows remain green on the exact proposal head.
Merged product tree is byte-identical to the tested proposal tree.

maximumImprovementChallenge.question: Is adding a fuzz/property dependency the highest-value change this run?
maximumImprovementChallenge.answer: No. The code review exposed an immediate cross-platform correctness gap already reachable through existing real browser evidence. Fixing the Windows-illegal name output added zero dependencies, changed only nonportable outputs, and could be proven through the existing Windows Chromium lane plus exact evidence redownload.
maximumImprovementChallenge.result: Merged the narrow portability fix and deferred fuzz-framework adoption until a candidate demonstrates unique actionable coverage.
